layman_headline: No clear swing trade setup today — the market is fearful and the candidates are weak.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a 'Fear' phase, which can sometimes create buying opportunities, but today's swing trade candidates are either exotic low-liquidity tokens (Kinesis Gold/Silver, Audiera, Unibase) or gold-backed stablecoins that already ran up 7% this week. Bitcoin and Ethereum are quietly recovering (+3% and +2.5% over 7 days), but the altcoin landscape is uninspiring. None of the candidates offer a clean technical setup with reliable volume and clear stop-losses.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait for a better setup. The market mood is improving but hasn't produced a high-conviction entry yet. Watch Bitcoin — if it holds above $65K, altcoins may follow with tradeable setups.
expert_reasoning: The swing candidate pool this cycle is extremely poor quality. KAG and KAU show 114%+ 24h moves but have no volume-vs-average data, no MACD cross info, and are niche precious-metals-backed tokens with thin liquidity — chasing these would violate risk management principles. BEAT dropped 49% in 7 days and 81% from ATH with zero technical indicators available — classic falling knife with no identifiable support. UB has a neutral RSI of 56 and is still above its SMA20 despite a -10.6% weekly drop, but it's an obscure micro-cap with no news catalyst. PAXG and XAUT are gold proxies already extended +7% on the week. BTC dominance at 56.8% signals continued alt weakness. Fear & Greed improving from 25 to 29 is mildly constructive but not actionable. The prudent move is to remain in hunting mode and wait for a setup with clear technicals on a liquid, established asset.
risk_factors: Entering exotic low-liquidity tokens (KAG, KAU, UB, BEAT) carries extreme slippage and exit risk
BTC dominance at 56.8% continues to suppress altcoin performance broadly

market_context: Bitcoin is recovering modestly at $64.9K with the market in Fear (29/100), improving from deeper fear levels last week. High BTC dominance at 56.8% and weak altcoin setups suggest patience over action.
context_banner: Market fear is easing but swing candidates this cycle are low-quality — disciplined patience protects capital.
